caption:
Israeli tanks have moved across the yellow line boundary into Hamas-controlled central Gaza.

This is the first time ground forces have crossed this specific line since the ceasefire deal was established last October.

This military movement is happening alongside complex political developments. Gadi Eisenkot is currently attempting to build a government coalition that does not include Benjamin Netanyahu.

story.title: Israeli tanks cross ‘yellow line’ boundary into Hamas-controlled central Gaza
story.summary: First incursion across boundary since ceasefire deal comes as Eisenkot seeks to form government without Netanyahu The Israeli military crossed into Hamas-controlled central Gaza on Wednesday in its first ground operation across the “yellow line” boundary since a fragile ceasefire was agreed last October, forcing dozens of displaced Palestinians to flee their tents.
